notes.title: [V28.1] New Online Multiplayer Mode
notes.content:
[h2]New Online Multiplayer Mode[/h2]

Barro now has an online multiplayer mode! But keep in mind that this is an initial version, still under development and lightly tested. Bugs might pop up along the way, so we appreciate your patience as we work on improving it.


[h2]Play with your friends[/h2]

You can now invite your friends on Steam to play together! Just make sure the game is open when sending the invite for it to work properly.


[h2]Starting grid based on the leaderboard[/h2]

In multiplayer mode, the starting grid will be ordered based on the leaderboard times. Show off your skills and secure a good starting position!


[h2]Few players online[/h2]

Since the mode is new, you might find only a few people playing online. So, it’s a good idea to invite your friends to have a better experience!


[h2]Issues and possible solutions[/h2]

    As this is an alpha version, problems may occur. If an error prevents the game from continuing, restart it and try again.

    If the host leaves the match, the game will end for all players. Make sure the host stays until the match is over.

    The function to ban players from a match is not available yet.

    For now, we recommend that only the host uses the pause function to avoid any issues.


[h2]Help us with the testing[/h2]

We haven’t tested the game with more than two devices, as we only have two available for testing. Your participation will be crucial in improving this experience. We count on the community to help us with these tests!


[h2]Thank you for your support![/h2]

We’d like to thank everyone who’s playing and helping Barro evolve. You keep the game alive and help make it better every day. We really appreciate it!

[h1]Changes to the leaderboard[/h1]
This update will change the leaderboard server and the way the game saves/loads data, because maintaining the old server has become too expensive.

The new version will fix some bugs and add some improvements for all games in the Barro series.

Unfortunately, the old times will not be transferred to the new server due to the modifications that were made, also because of a bug that I ended up finding that allowed better times to be achieved on some occasions. For these reasons, all leaderboards have been reset. Sorry.

notes.title: V.19.0 [Barro Series]
notes.content:
In this new version of the Barro series you get a new plugin to handle inputs. (It's the same plugin that runs in games like The Long Dark.)

This will give you more options for configuring the inputs and will also make it possible to choose which controller the player wants to play with. (Before the controller defined the player)

I'm still integrating the plugin into the game and improvements are yet to be made, as well as a more appropriate translation for the game.

*If you notice something wrong with the new update, please use the game's forum to report it, thanks.

notes.content:
The Barro series will be updated to a new version (V.13). In this new version we will have a new UI and a new version of the leaderboard.

notes.title: DLCs will be removed from the store.
notes.content:
Hello guys, I'm here to announce that I have decided to remove all the DLCs from the store. If you already own one or more DLCs the content from these DLCs will continue to be available for you.

After 2 years of feedback from the players (mostly negative) about the DLCs and after some considerations I have decided to remove it permanently from the store.

[b]The following games will be affected:[/b]

[h1]Andarilho:[/h1]
For the game Andarilho, the DLCs will be removed but, the content from it will be added to the game. If you own a DLC, you will receive one or more items on your Steam inventory relative to that DLC. A new update will be released soon and I will announce later all the changes and new items for the game.


[h1]Barro[/h1]
For Barro, the extra tracks will be available only for those who own the DLC and it will no longer be possible to buy it in the future.


[h1]Ninja Stealth[/h1]
For Ninja Stealth, the extra content was only cosmetic and it will be available only for those who already own the DLC.


[h1]Ninja Stealth 2[/h1]
Like Ninja Stealth, the extra content was only cosmetic and it will be available only for those who already own the DLC.


[h1]Ninja Stealth 3[/h1]
The extra levels and the laser customisation will be available only for those who already own the DLC. It doesn't interferes on the main game.


[b]The following DLCs will no longer be available for purchase:[/b]

ːns_redːAndarilho - Aliens
ːns_redːAndarilho - Guns
ːns_redːAndarilho - Vehicles
ːns_redːAndarilho - Zombies 

ːns_redːBarro - Track Pack 1
ːns_redːBarro - Track Pack 2

ːns_redːNinja Stealth - Supporter Edition 

ːns_redːNinja Stealth 2 - Golden Edition

ːns_redːNinja Stealth 3 - Custom Lasers
ːns_redːNinja Stealth 3 - Extra Levels #1



If you have any questions, feel free to contact me and I will be happy to help you.




SC Jogos
